$comment: 语法大厅 G15（V0.9 P2a 骨架层）。比喻锚点：别在半路转调（G大调拉一半转降E）。与 KET 八课 L4 共用「时态=曲子的调」比喻（L4 原文：拉琴时 G 大调拉到一半突然转降 E，全场都会皱眉；写之前先默念：这个故事发生在过去→每个动词都盖过去戳；自查法：把每个动词圈出来问它是过去形状吗），L4 零改动。全部内容原创。
title: 叙事时态一致
metaphor: 别在半路转调（G大调拉一半转降E）
ketNote: 时态一致是 KET Part 7 看图写故事的第一评分点：故事定了过去调，一个动词跳回现在就是最扎眼的失分。八课里的亲戚是 L4。

sections.essence: 时态是曲子的调：开头定了过去调，每个动词都在调里，别半路转调。
sections.why: 中文讲故事，时间只交代一次就够了：「昨天我们去公园，看见一只小猫，喂了它半根火腿肠」——「去、看见、喂」三个动词全都纹丝不动，反正开头说了「昨天」。英语不行：时间戳刻在每个动词身上，讲过去的故事，每一个动词都要各自盖上过去戳，一个都不能漏。漏掉一个，就像乐队拉着 G 大调忽然蹦出一个降 E 的音——意思未必听不懂，但每个听的人都会皱眉。KET 看图写故事恰恰盯着这一点打分：全篇过去调稳稳不转，是判卷人对「会写故事」最直接的印象；写三句转两次调，内容再好也白搭。
sections.metaphorStory: 银帆乐团排一首 G 大调的曲子。前半段顺顺当当，到了中段，新来的小号手忽然按降 E 调吹了一句——音没有错音，调错了，全场齐刷刷皱起眉头。指挥敲敲谱架：「曲子开头定了调，后面每一个音都活在这个调里。想转调可以，得整曲一起转，不能你一个人转。」写英语故事一模一样：第一句 Last Sunday, Mia walked to the lake. 里的 walked 一落笔，全篇就是过去调。后面她看见什么、做了什么——saw、picked、ran——每个动词都得在过去调里。谁要是中途写了个 sees，那就是小号手那声突兀的降 E。只有两处例外，像乐曲里合法的「转调记号」：引号里的人物对话可以用现在调（说话那一刻是人物的「现场」），永远为真的事实可以不转（太阳每天都升起）。除此之外，一调到底。

cards.detail: 故事开头的时间词和第一个动词一起定下全篇的调——Last Sunday + walked，全篇过去调。
cards.example: Last Sunday, Mia walked to the lake.

cards.rule: 定调后，每个动词都盖戳
cards.detail: 过去调里的每一个动词都要是过去形状，规则的盖 -ed，不规则的用私章——一个漏戳就是转调。
cards.example: She saw a duck, picked up some bread and fed it.

cards.rule: and 后面的动词最容易漏戳
cards.detail: 一句里连着几个动作时，第一个记得盖戳、第二个忘了——and 后面的动词同样要过去形状。
cards.example: He opened the box and found a letter.（不是 and finds）

cards.rule: 合法转调①：引号里的对话
cards.detail: 人物开口说话时，引号里是他的「现场」，可以用现在调；引号外的 said 仍在过去调。

cards.rule: 合法转调②：永远为真的事实
cards.detail: 太阳升起、水会结冰这类永真事实，写在过去的故事里也可以保持现在调。
cards.example: Grandpa told me the sun rises in the east.

cards.detail: 写完只检查一件事：把每个动词圈出来，问「它是过去形状吗」。一个不是，改成是。

basic.en: Last night, Ben finished his homework and went to bed early.
basic.cn: 昨晚本写完作业就早早睡了。（finished、went 都在过去调）

basic.en: Yesterday morning, we cleaned the classroom and watered the plants.
basic.cn: 昨天早上我们打扫了教室，给植物浇了水。

basic.en: She opened her bag, took out a book and began to read.
basic.cn: 她打开书包，拿出一本书开始读。（三个动词三枚戳）

basic.en: Last week, my cousin visited us and stayed for two days.
basic.cn: 上周我表哥来看我们，住了两天。

basic.en: The little cat jumped onto the sofa and fell asleep.

mid.en: One rainy afternoon, Tom found a wet kitten and carried it home.
mid.cn: 一个下雨的下午，汤姆发现一只淋湿的小猫，把它抱回了家。（开头定调，全篇跟着走）

mid.en: When the concert ended, everyone stood up and clapped.
mid.cn: 音乐会结束时，所有人起立鼓掌。

mid.en: He said, "I like this song very much."
mid.cn: 他说：「我特别喜欢这首歌。」（引号里是合法的现在调）

mid.en: The teacher told us that light travels faster than sound.
mid.cn: 老师告诉我们光比声音跑得快。（永真事实不转调）

mid.en: While they were rowing, a fish jumped into the boat.
mid.cn: 他们划着船，一条鱼跳进了船里。（过去进行+一般过去，仍是过去调）

trap.en: Lily got up late, so she ran all the way to school.
trap.cn: 莉莉起晚了，所以一路跑去学校。
trap.note: so 后面的动词也在过去调里——ran 别写成 runs。

trap.en: He turned off the light and lay down.
trap.note: lie 的过去式是 lay——第二个动词最容易漏戳或用错私章。
asked 在过去调；引号里的 is 是人物现场，不算转调。

trap.en: I knew the answer because I read the book last month.
trap.cn: 我知道答案，因为上个月我读过那本书。
trap.note: read 的过去式拼写不变——看着像现在调，其实已经盖了戳。

trap.en: The guide said that the museum opens at nine every day.
trap.cn: 导游说博物馆每天九点开门。
trap.note: 「每天九点开门」是至今仍真的时刻表，保持现在调是合法转调。

trap.en: She was tired, but she still smiled at us.
trap.cn: 她很累，但仍冲我们微笑。
trap.note: be 也是动词——was 和 smiled 一起待在过去调里，别把 was 写成 is。

redBlack.bad: Yesterday I lose my keys, so I can't open the door.（说昨天的事）
redBlack.good: Yesterday I lost my keys, so I couldn't open the door.
redBlack.why: 全句没一个过去戳，听的人分不清是昨天丢了还是现在正丢着——时间线整个乱掉。

redBlack.bad: When they are at the lake, they caught a big fish.（讲上周的故事）
redBlack.good: When they were at the lake, they caught a big fish.
redBlack.why: 前半现在调后半过去调，「在湖边」和「钓到鱼」变成两个时空的事——听的人对不上。

redBlack.bad: Last Sunday we went to the zoo and see many monkeys.
redBlack.good: Last Sunday we went to the zoo and saw many monkeys.
redBlack.why: and 后面的动词漏了戳——went 盖了，see 也得变 saw。

redBlack.bad: She opened the door and smiles at me.
redBlack.good: She opened the door and smiled at me.
redBlack.why: 第二个动词半路转调——smiles 要回到过去调 smiled。

redBlack.bad: The story was funny, so everyone laughs.
redBlack.good: The story was funny, so everyone laughed.
redBlack.why: so 后面还在同一个故事里——laughs 是那声突兀的降 E。

redBlack.bad: He picked up the phone and says hello.
redBlack.good: He picked up the phone and said hello.
redBlack.why: says 转调了——引号外的「说」要用 said。

redBlack.bad: While I was walking home, I meet my old friend.
redBlack.good: While I was walking home, I met my old friend.
redBlack.why: 长镜头 was walking 已定过去调，快门动作也要盖戳——met。

redBlack.bad: Last term our class win the singing contest.
redBlack.good: Last term our class won the singing contest.
redBlack.why: last term 定了调，win 却没变形——won。

redBlack.bad: It was late, but the shop is still open.（讲昨晚）
redBlack.good: It was late, but the shop was still open.
redBlack.why: be 也是动词，也得在调里——was open。

redBlack.bad: First he washed his hands, then he eat the apple.
redBlack.good: First he washed his hands, then he ate the apple.
redBlack.why: then 后面的动作还在故事里——eat 要用私章 ate。

redBlack.bad: My teacher said that the earth went around the sun.
redBlack.good: My teacher said that the earth goes around the sun.
redBlack.why: 永真事实保持现在调更好；写成过去调意思不挡，KET 也不设这个坑。

redBlack.bad: So I run to the door, and guess what I saw!（讲故事时的口语腔）
redBlack.good: So I ran to the door, and guess what I saw!
redBlack.why: 口语讲故事有人爱用现在调助兴（历史现在时），聊天不算错；书面故事要一调到底。

contrast.cn: 昨天我们去公园，看见小猫，喂了它。（动词全不变）
contrast.en: We went to the park, saw a kitten and fed it.（三个动词三枚戳）
contrast.diff: 中文时间说一次全篇有效；英语每个动词各自报时，一个漏报就是病句。

contrast.cn: 他打开门，冲我笑。（不用管「笑」的时间）
contrast.en: He opened the door and smiled at me.
contrast.diff: 中文的连续动作搭「了／就」自然连贯；英语 and 后面的动词最容易漏戳。

contrast.cn: 妈妈说：「我很开心。」（里外都不用变）
contrast.en: Mum said, "I am so happy."（外面过去调，引号里现在调）
contrast.diff: 英语把「说」和「说的话」分成两个时空：said 在故事里，引号里是人物的现场。

contrast.cn: 老师说太阳从东边升起。（没有时态问题）
contrast.en: The teacher said the sun rises in the east.
contrast.diff: 英语给永真事实开了绿灯：故事在过去调，事实可以留在现在调。

contrast.cn: 讲完故事没人检查动词。
contrast.en: 写完圈出每个动词问：它是过去形状吗？
contrast.diff: 中文没有这道工序；英语写手的最后一步永远是「查调」。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 开头定调，动词圈一圈；引号和真理放行，其余全盖戳。
steps: 动笔前先默念：这个故事发生在过去 → 每个动词都盖过去戳。
写完把每个动词圈出来，一个一个问：「它是过去形状吗？」
圈到 and / so / then 后面的动词时多看一眼——这里最容易漏戳。
圈到引号里的动词？人物的现场，现在调放行。
圈到永真事实（太阳升起、水会结冰）？现在调放行；其余一律改成过去形状。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，英语故事像一首曲子：开头定了调，后面每个音都得在调里。你用英语给我讲个昨天的小故事吧，三四句就行。我不懂英语没关系，我只当听众数动词——要是听到 is、am、are 或者动词带着 s 的音混进昨天的故事里，我就轻敲一下桌子，那是『转调提醒』，你自己找找哪个动词跳了调。」玩熟以后升级：让她故意在故事里藏一个转调的动词，换你来敲桌子——找错方向的游戏最能练出她自查的耳朵。
questions: 英语故事的「调」是由什么定下来的？定了以后谁必须跟着走？
She opened the door and smiles. 哪个动词转调了？该改成什么？
什么时候允许在过去的故事里用现在调？（提示：引号里的话、永远为真的事实）

sections.echo: 口语里其实一直有人「合法转调」：老一辈说书人讲到紧要处爱换现在时——「他推门就进，一看，桌上摆着一封信」——英语也一样，聊天讲故事常冒出 So he says to me...，语言学家管它叫「历史现在时」，用现在调把听众拽到现场。但书面叙事的规矩恰恰相反：一调到底才显功力。英语动词的变化尾巴几百年来磨掉了一大半，剩下的过去戳是少数还必须遵守的规矩——越是仅存的规矩，考试越盯得紧。

memoryCard.alt: G15 记忆卡：叙事时态一致=开头定调全篇跟走；and/so/then 后与 be 动词是最易转调路口；引号对话与永真事实是两个合法转调；写完圈动词自查。

questions.q: 英语故事的「调」由什么定下来？
options: 开头的时间词和第一个动词
questions.explain: Last Sunday + walked 一落笔，全篇就是过去调。

questions.q: 故事定了过去调后，后面的动词要怎么办？
questions.explain: 每个动词各自盖戳，一个都不能漏。

questions.q: 「半路转调」指的是什么毛病？
options: 过去的故事里混进现在时动词
questions.explain: 全篇过去调里冒出一个现在形状的动词，就像 G 大调里蹦出降 E。

questions.q: Last night, Ben ___ his homework early. 调应该是？
questions.explain: last night 定了过去调。

questions.q: 引号里的人物对话可以用什么调？
options: 现在调（那是人物的现场）
questions.explain: She said, "I am happy!"——引号里是合法转调。

questions.q: 永远为真的事实写进过去的故事里，可以？
questions.explain: the sun rises in the east——永真事实不转调。

questions.q: 写完故事的自查法是？
options: 圈出每个动词问「它是过去形状吗」
questions.explain: L4 教的老办法：一个不是，改成是。

questions.q: 一句里连着几个动作，哪个动词最容易漏戳？
questions.explain: went and sees ✗——and 后面的动词同样要盖戳。

questions.q: went and sees 这个组合病在哪？
questions.explain: went 在过去调，sees 跳回现在调——改 saw。

questions.q: be 动词在过去的故事里该长什么样？
questions.explain: be 也是动词，也要待在调里。

questions.q: She was tired, but she still ___ at us.
questions.explain: was 已定过去调——smiled。

questions.q: 下面哪句没有转调？
options: He came in and sat down.
He came in and sits down.
He comes in and sat down.
questions.explain: came、sat 都在过去调里。

questions.q: 「历史现在时」是什么？
options: 口语讲故事时故意用现在调助兴
questions.explain: 聊天可以，书面故事要一调到底。

questions.q: so / then 后面的动作在故事里要用？
options: 跟全篇一样的过去形状
questions.explain: so、then 不是出口，后面还在故事里。

questions.q: read 出现在过去的故事里，怎么判断它盖没盖戳？
options: 拼写不变，靠上下文和读音 /red/
questions.explain: read 的过去式拼写完全一样——别误判它转调。

questions.q: 检查这句：Mum asked, "Where is your coat?" 转调了吗？
options: 没有——引号里是人物现场
questions.explain: asked 在过去调，引号里的 is 合法。

questions.q: Last Sunday, we went fishing and ___ three fish.
questions.explain: went 定了调——and 后面照样盖戳：caught。

questions.q: She picked up the kitten and ___ it home.
questions.explain: picked 在过去调——carried。

questions.q: Yesterday Tom got up late, so he ___ the school bus.
questions.explain: so 后面还在故事里——missed。

questions.q: The music stopped and everyone ___ quiet.
questions.explain: stopped 定调——became。

questions.q: He opened the letter, ___ it twice and smiled.
questions.explain: read 过去式拼写不变——夹在 opened 和 smiled 中间正合调。

questions.q: When the rain stopped, the children ___ outside.
questions.explain: stopped 定过去调——ran。

questions.q: Last night the soup ___ too hot, so I waited.
questions.explain: be 动词也要在调里——was。

questions.q: Grandma smiled and said, "You ___ taller every year!"
questions.explain: 引号里是奶奶的现场——现在调 get 合法。

questions.q: The teacher told us that water ___ at 0 degrees.
questions.explain: 永真事实保持现在调——freezes。

questions.q: First she washed the apples, then she ___ them on the plate.
questions.explain: then 后面还在调里——put（过去式拼写不变）。

questions.q: While he was running, his hat ___ off.
questions.explain: was running 已在过去调——快门动作 flew。

questions.q: The bird flew in, ___ around the room and went out.
questions.explain: 三个动作一条调：flew、circled、went。

questions.q: I dropped my ice cream and my little sister ___.
questions.explain: dropped 定调——laughed。

questions.q: Last week our team practised hard and ___ the match.
questions.explain: practised 在过去调——won。

questions.q: He said, "My favourite subject ___ music."
questions.explain: 引号里是他的现场——is 合法转调。

questions.q: The wind blew hard, and the door ___ shut.
questions.explain: blew 定调——banged。

stages.name: 改一改 · 揪出转调音

questions.q: 哪句从头到尾没转调？
options: We visited the farm and fed the sheep.
We visited the farm and feed the sheep.
We visit the farm and fed the sheep.
questions.explain: visited、fed 都在过去调。

questions.q: 哪句从头到尾一个调？
options: She heard a noise and turned around.
She heard a noise and turns around.
She hears a noise and turned around.
questions.explain: heard + turned——不转调。

questions.q: 哪句的 be 动词没跳调？
options: The street was wet because it rained all night.
The street is wet because it rained all night yesterday.
The street was wet because it rains all night.
questions.explain: was + rained 同调；另外两句各有一个动词跳去现在调。

questions.q: 哪句的第二个动词盖了戳？
options: He took out his key and unlocked the door.
He took out his key and unlocks the door.
He takes out his key and unlocked the door.
questions.explain: took + unlocked——and 后面照样盖戳。

questions.q: 哪句的引号用法全对？
options: Dad said, "Dinner was ready."（想说：开饭啦）
questions.explain: said 在过去调；引号里 is 是爸爸的现场。

questions.q: 哪句把永真事实处理对了？
options: Miss Li told us that the moon goes around the earth.
Miss Li tells us last week that the moon went around the earth.
Miss Li told us that the moon go around the earth.
questions.explain: told 在过去调；永真事实 goes 保持现在调。

questions.q: 哪句的三个动词一条调？
options: She came home, drank some milk and went to bed.
She came home, drinks some milk and went to bed.
She came home, drank some milk and goes to bed.
questions.explain: came、drank、went——三枚戳一个不少。

questions.q: 哪句的 so 没带偏调？
options: The box was heavy, so we carried it together.
The box was heavy, so we carry it together.
The box is heavy, so we carried it together yesterday.
questions.explain: was + carried 同调。

questions.q: 哪句的快门动作盖了戳？
options: While she was singing, the lights suddenly changed.
While she was singing, the lights suddenly change.
While she sings, the lights suddenly changed.
questions.explain: was singing 定调，快门 changed 同调。

questions.q: 哪句不用改？
options: Everyone was hungry, but nobody said a word.
Everyone was hungry, but nobody says a word.
Everyone is hungry, but nobody said a word.（讲昨晚）
questions.explain: was + said——两个动词同在过去调。

questions.q: 哪句的 then 后面没跳调？
options: He fed the dog, then he swept the yard.
He fed the dog, then he sweeps the yard.
He feeds the dog, then he swept the yard.
questions.explain: fed + swept——then 不是出口。

questions.q: 哪句的 because 前后同调？
options: She was late because she forgot her bag.
She was late because she forgets her bag.
She is late because she forgot her bag yesterday.
questions.explain: was + forgot——原因也在故事里。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（他停下车，向我们招手）
options: He stopped his bike and waved to us.
He stopped his bike and waves to us.
He stops his bike and waved to us.
questions.explain: stopped + waved 一条调。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（她说她八岁）
options: She said, "I am eight years old."
She said, "I was eight years old."（想说现在八岁）
She says last year, "I am eight."
questions.explain: 引号里的自我介绍是现场——am。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（我们等了很久，车终于来了）
options: We waited a long time, and the bus finally came.
We waited a long time, and the bus finally comes.
We wait a long time, and the bus finally came.
questions.explain: waited + came——「终于」也不许转调。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（灯灭了，全场安静下来）
options: The lights went out, and the hall became quiet.
The lights go out, and the hall became quiet.
The lights went out, and the hall becomes quiet.
questions.explain: went + became——两个动词一条调。

stages.name: 用一用 · 整段不转调

questions.q: One morning, Mia ___ a strange box in the garden. She ___ it slowly.
questions.explain: 开头 found 定调，opened 跟上——两枚戳齐。

questions.q: The dog ___ at the door because it ___ a stranger outside.
questions.explain: barked + heard——because 前后同调。

questions.q: When the show ended, we ___ our coats and ___ home.
questions.explain: ended 定调——took、walked 都盖戳。

questions.q: He ___ the ladder, ___ the kite from the tree and climbed down.
questions.explain: 三个动作一条调：climbed、took、climbed down。

questions.q: She ___ nervous, but when the music started, she ___ beautifully.
questions.explain: felt + danced——情绪和动作都在过去调。

questions.q: Tom ___ to the shop, but it ___ closed.
questions.explain: hurried + was——be 动词也在调里。

questions.q: Dad ___ and said, "This soup ___ delicious!"
questions.explain: smiled 在过去调；引号里是爸爸的现场——is。

questions.q: The guide explained that this river ___ into the sea, and we ___ many photos.
questions.explain: 河流入海是至今仍真的事实——flows；拍照在故事里——took。

questions.q: I ___ my homework, ___ my schoolbag and went to sleep.
questions.explain: 三连动作全盖戳：finished、packed、went。

questions.q: While the children ___ sandcastles, a big wave ___ in.
questions.explain: 长镜头 were building + 快门 came——都在过去调。

questions.q: She lost her ticket, ___ everywhere, and finally ___ it in her shoe.
questions.explain: lost 定调——looked、found 一路跟到底。

questions.q: The old man ___ us that honey never ___ bad.
questions.explain: told 在故事里；「蜂蜜永不变质」是永真事实——goes。

questions.q: It ___ dark, so we ___ the lamp and kept reading.
questions.explain: got + turned——so 后面不许转调。

questions.q: The phone rang. Lily ___ it up and ___, "Hello?"
questions.explain: rang 定调——picked、said 同调；Hello 在引号里自由。

questions.q: 找出全对的一段：
options: Last Friday we baked cookies. The kitchen smelled sweet, and everyone wanted one.
Last Friday we baked cookies. The kitchen smells sweet, and everyone wanted one.
Last Friday we bake cookies. The kitchen smelled sweet, and everyone wants one.
questions.explain: baked、smelled、wanted——整段一条过去调。

questions.q: 大考：One evening, a cat ___ into our yard, ___ at my dog, and they ___ friends.
questions.explain: 一段三动词三枚戳：walked、looked、became——一个漏戳全段皱眉。

detective.sentence: Last Saturday we climbed the hill and enjoy the view.
detective.fixed: Last Saturday we climbed the hill and enjoyed the view.
detective.clue: and 后面的第二个动词漏了戳——enjoy 要改 enjoyed。

detective.sentence: She opened the fridge and takes out some juice.
detective.fixed: She opened the fridge and took out some juice.
detective.clue: opened 定了过去调，takes 是半路转调——用私章 took。

detective.sentence: The film was boring, so we leave early.
detective.fixed: The film was boring, so we left early.
detective.clue: so 后面还在故事里——leave 要盖戳变 left。

detective.sentence: When I got home, my little brother is watching TV.
detective.fixed: When I got home, my little brother was watching TV.
detective.clue: got 定了过去调，is 跳回现在——改 was，长镜头也要在调里。

detective.sentence: He said, "I was very happy today!"（他当场很开心）
detective.fixed: He said, "I am very happy today!"
detective.clue: 引号里是人物的现场——当场的开心用 am，别把引号里也盖上过去戳。

detective.sentence: Yesterday it rains hard, so the match was put off.
detective.fixed: Yesterday it rained hard, so the match was put off.
detective.clue: yesterday 定调，rains 没盖戳——rained；后半句没病，别多改。

detective.sentence: The teacher told us that the earth is round, and we wrote it down. — 这句有病吗？
detective.fixed: 没病：地球是圆的属于永真事实，is 是合法转调；told、wrote 都在调里。
detective.clue: 侦探也要会放人——先确认是不是「永真事实」这张通行证。
